verdict:
KILL. This is the cleanest disposition in the batch: two benches at 8/10 conviction, converging on FLAT from opposite directions, with the blue bench closing the one coverage gap red left open. No escalation trigger fires - benches are concordant on outcome, there is no ADVANCE, the name is not held, and there is no print inside the window (Q2 8-K filed 2026-08-10; next print 2026-11-12 yfinance-derived and UNCONFIRMED).

WHAT BLUE OVERTURNED, AND WHY IT DOES NOT RESCUE THE NAME. Red's strongest single kill was revealed preference: 'zero net buyback into the deepest discount, every repurchase at $10.24 average - all above today's price.' Blue read the same exhibit properly and found the $10.24 is a BLEND ARTIFACT that red's own cited document decomposes: 2025 bought 1,938,450 sh at ~$16.35; Q2-2026 bought 2,132,773 sh for $10.0M at ~$4.69 - below today's tape, near the $4.46 low, i.e. squarely AT the deepest discount. This is the III precedent exactly (a killer fact that is an aggregation artifact), and it is the second time this court has produced that error class. Management is also two-sided around NAV - buying 2.1M shares at $4.69 while issuing $75M at $7.49 in the same quarter, per-share-accretive in both directions. 'Institutionally incapable of buybacks' is simply wrong.

BUT THE REJECT SURVIVES ON FOUR INDEPENDENT LEGS, three of which red never needed: (1) SCALE - $10M/quarter is 0.67% of the authorization and ~1%/yr of float; that is not a discount-closure catalyst at a 20%+ discount no matter how well-timed. The Q1-zero / Q2-heavy pattern implies a repurchase trigger around ~0.6x mNAV; at today's 0.77-0.80x the revealed behaviour is staking, not buying. (2) THE LST TAIL IS ESCALATING AND IS NOW PRIMARY-SOURCED - 254,097 ETH-equivalent (28.6%) in as-if-redeemed LsETH/weETH with $76.1M of impairment already booked against that mark, plus $200M deployed into additional wstETH via Lido three days after printing a 0.80-mNAV quarter; blue confirmed from the PR body that there is no rotation language and the source is unspecified, so the native-funded reading holds and the sleeve goes pro forma to ~40.6%. The bull case wanted the discount to close; management is enlarging the exact asset that explains why it is open. (3) THE WARRANT WALL - blue closed red's TENX cap-structure gap and found 16,312,635 warrants at a $7.77 WAEP, of which 10.01M struck at $8.15 from the June RDO sit just ABOVE the $7.89 NAV. Treasury-method dilution at the current tape is nil, so NAV/share stands - but that supply is a structural cap on any mNAV recovery. This is a discount-PERSISTENCE mechanism that neither the thesis nor red had, and it is the most useful new fact in the record. (4) MANDATE - the dominant term is unhedged ETH beta at the thesis's own beta of 10.56, which means the 20% discount cushion is one bad ETH week. Per the fairly-paid-risk doctrine, RP_FAIR requires fairness VERIFIED and tails BOUNDED; the LST sleeve is unbounded and growing, so it fails the bar regardless of whether the discount is fairly struck. Blue also checked orphan discipline correctly - SBET has 13G coverage and sits in the DAT cohort, so the RP_FAIR orphan rescue does not apply.

RED'S SURVIVING FINDINGS: the tax mechanism was garbled in the thesis and blue sustained the correction - ~889k ETH acquired for ~$3.3bn is ~$3,710/ETH basis against ~$1,871 spot, an embedded LOSS; selling realises losses, there is no gain to shelter. And hi52 $22.72 was a >2x mNAV price, so the '26% residual de-rating' measures premium-unwind, not capturable damage.

DOCTRINAL CORRECTION TO THE EXISTING LEDGER ENTRY - THIS IS THE ACTIONABLE PART. SBET currently sits WATCH with alert_below $4.73, gate_basis 'management's revealed Q2-2026 buyback zone ($4.69 avg).' That is a PRICE gate applied to a kill whose basis is NOT valuation. Per the response taxonomy, valuation findings get a price gate; business-risk findings get a size cut; mandate/tail findings get neither. The four legs above are business-risk and mandate, not valuation - the discount arithmetic is CONFIRMED, it is everything else that fails. A price alert at $4.73 will therefore fire on a cheaper version of an asset the desk still does not want, and it will fire precisely when ETH beta has done the damage that makes it un-ownable. Convert to AVOID with EVENT gates only. Note the price level is not useless as INFORMATION (it marks management's revealed repurchase trigger) - but it must not be the entry instrument.

TAPE, VERIFIED AT ADJUDICATION (IBKR live - both benches were price-blind, third and fourth consecutive permission-denial): last $6.23, prior close $6.32, 52w high $21.21, open_52w $22.50, 52w low $4.46. dd52 = -70.6% vs pack -0.772 and bench -72.2%; pct_off_low = +39.7% vs bench +41.7%. Bench figures are directionally right and derived from the $6.32 close. mNAV at $6.23 against blue's $7.89 NAV = 0.79 - unchanged verdict. No forced seller anywhere in the record; the dislocation doctrine is unsatisfied, this is a premium-unwind on a vehicle whose premium was the entire product. || SESSION RULING: RATIFIED KILL (concordant 8/10) + the draft's ledger fix APPLIED: the $4.73 price gate is RETIRED — a valuation instrument cannot gate a mandate/unbounded-tail kill (response taxonomy: data/integrity kills, price gates are for valuation objections only). No re-entry price exists for an asset the desk can't own.

court.record: batch 8/15; red 8/blue 8 PARTIALLY OVERTURNED on grounds - outcome CONCORDANT. Blue demolished red's headline kill (the 'revealed preference / zero buyback' finding) but independently re-derived REJECT on stronger footing. Both benches land FLAT at 8/10.

reopen_gates: EVENT (blue's re-court trigger, primary): a DISCLOSED repurchase of >= $50M in a quarter, OR shares outstanding FALLING while mNAV < 0.85. Either proves closure willingness at a scale that matters; $10M/qtr does not.
EVENT: a committed 10b5-1 buyback with dollars and dates attached (red's change-my-mind). Authorization alone is not evidence - 0.67% of the authorization has been used.

STRUCTURAL: disclosure that an LST deployment rotated FROM LsETH/weETH rather than adding to it - i.e. diversification rather than escalation of the sleeve. Absent that, treat every new staking PR as tail-enlarging.

STRUCTURAL: the ~10.01M warrants struck at $8.15 (June RDO) expire, are repriced, or are exercised/retired. Until then there is a structural supply wall sitting just above the $7.89 NAV that caps mNAV recovery.

DO NOT USE A PRICE GATE. The existing alert_below $4.73 must be retired as an ENTRY instrument (see verdict_text). Keep $4.69-4.73 recorded only as the observed management repurchase trigger - information, not a buy signal.

MANDATE (blocking, supersedes all of the above): the desk has no crypto-beta mandate. Even a fully closed discount leaves unhedged ETH beta at ~10.56x with an unbounded LST tail, which fails the fairly-paid-risk bar (fairness verified AND tails bounded). Blue ruled FLAT with NO instrument - explicitly including ETHA/spot, which solve beta hygiene but not the absence of a mandate. Any re-court must clear the mandate question FIRST, before the discount question.
